Nostrabingo - Travel through Time and Space with a Word Game!
=============================================================

Welcome to Nostrabingo - a unique and exciting word game that takes you on a journey through time and space!

Objective
---------

Your goal is to explore different eras and locations, collecting words and phrases along the way. Each word or phrase you collect will reveal a portion of a hidden map, leading you closer to the ultimate prize - the Secret Word.

Gameplay
--------

Here's how to play:

1. Choose a time period and location from the menu.
2. Click on the "Spin" button to generate a random word or phrase related to your chosen era and location.
3. Use the " millones" button to earn millions of points and unlock special features.
4. Collect as many words and phrases as possible to progress through the game and unlock new eras and locations.
5. Use the "Hint" button to get a hint about the next word or phrase you need to collect.
6. Use the "Jump" button to skip ahead to the next level or to a specific location.
7. When you have collected all the words and phrases for a given era and location, you will unlock a new era and location to explore.
8. The first player to find the Secret Word wins the game!

Power-Ups
---------

As you play, you will encounter power-ups that can help you on your journey. Here are some of the power-ups you can collect:

1. Time Machine: Allows you to move ahead in time to a future era or location.
2. Map: Shows you the location of the next word or phrase on the map.
3. Millions: Earns you millions of points and unlocks special features.
4. Hint: Gives you a hint about the next word or phrase you need to collect.
5. Jump: Allows you to skip ahead to the next level or to a specific location.

Era and Location Menu
--------------------

Here is the list of eras and locations you can choose from:

* Ancient Egypt
* Medieval Europe
* Renaissance Italy
* Industrial Revolution England
* Modern-Day New York City
* Space Station Alpha

Each era and location has its own set of words and phrases to collect, and each one will take you on a unique journey through time and space.

Tips and Tricks
--------------

Here are some tips and tricks to help you on your journey:

1. Pay attention to the clues and hints available on the map and in the game. They can help you find the next word or phrase more quickly.
2. Use the "Jump" button to skip ahead to a specific location or level if you get stuck.
3. Use the "Hint" button to get a hint about the next word or phrase you need to collect.
4. Keep an eye out for power-ups, such as the Time Machine and Map, to help you on your journey.
5. Don't be afraid to take risks and explore new locations and eras. You never know what you might find!

Good luck, traveler! Your journey through time and space begins now!
